issue_comments.body: https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/143209 was backported to 3.13, but 3.13 does not have `FT_ATOMIC_ADD_SSIZE`, so I propose to implement local `_FT_ATOMIC_ADD_SSIZE` macro in `Objects/memoryobject.c`.

Thanks @sobolevn for the PR 🌮🎉.. I'm working now to backport this PR to: 3.13, 3.14, 3.15.
🐍🍒⛏🤖
